data.one_liner: Automatically resizes text to fit perfectly within its bounds.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AutoSizeText widget that behaves like standard Text but automatically adjusts its font size to prevent overflow within its container constraints. It supports rich text, custom min/max font sizes, step granularity, preset sizes, and synchronizing multiple text sizes via groups.
use_when: You need text to shrink automatically to fit a specific container width or height
You want to synchronize font sizes across multiple text elements using groups
You want to specify preset font sizes or a fallback overflow replacement widget
avoid_when: The container has unbounded constraints (like an unconstrained Row or Column) without using Expanded or SizedBox
You want a complex layout component rather than a single-purpose text scaling widget
strengths: Drop-in replacement for standard Flutter Text widgets
Group feature allows syncing font sizes across multiple text widgets
weaknesses: Requires bounded constraints to calculate scaling properly
Setting an unreasonably high initial font size can impact performance
data.minimal_example:
AutoSizeText(
  'The text to display',
  style: TextStyle(fontSize: 20),
  maxLines: 2,
)
